failureText: Chrome returned: Either the '<all_urls>' or 'activeTab' permission is required.
fix: Changed extension host_permissions to literal <all_urls>, synced the active loaded extension manifest, reloaded the unpacked extension with Computer Use, and documented the permission tradeoff.
retest: reports/main-baseline-seo-final-20260425001652/results.jsonl shows baseline screenshot pass with screenshot path reports/main-baseline-seo-final-20260425001652/screenshots/baseline-baseline-1777069015920.png.

failureText: The first combined download fixture landed CSV, then XLSX timed out.
fix: Changed the downloads suite to use a fresh localhost origin for each CSV/XLSX/PDF/blob case so Chrome's multiple-automatic-download guardrail is not confused with bridge download detection.
retest: reports/full-suite-20260424214958/results.jsonl shows CSV, XLSX, PDF, blob CSV, and rendered PDF screenshot pass.

failureText: A public page produced a Chrome error-page DOM and aborted the whole research suite.
fix: Changed research suite to log per-page warnings and continue to remaining public pages.
retest: reports/main-social-research-retest-20260424235905/results.jsonl shows social pass and research suite pass with example.com warning plus Wikipedia/Hacker News passes.

failureText: Initial Ahrefs suite could read Overview text/html but all CSV exports timed out because final Export clicks were not scoped to the modal.
fix: Inspected the Ahrefs modal through the bridge, confirmed CSV UTF-8 was already selected, changed the runner to use a dialog-scoped final Export click, and tightened report-specific filename matching.
retest: reports/main-ahrefs-retest2-20260425000618/results.jsonl shows Overview text/html plus Top Pages, Organic Keywords, and Refdomains CSVs pass.

failureText: Cleanup suite parser missed lsof listener ports because the port and (LISTEN) fields were split.
fix: Fixed lsof port parsing and added npm run cleanup:test to kill only 47822-47836 while preserving the registered 47821 MCP listener.
retest: reports/main-cleanup-retest-20260425000742/results.jsonl shows portsBefore and portsAfter both only [47821].

failureText: After several successful Ahrefs exports in quick succession, a single all-in-one stress run timed out waiting for fresh Top Pages and Organic Keywords CSVs.
fix: No bridge code change yet. Treat this as repeated-download or Ahrefs/Chrome throttling risk. Use focused Ahrefs lanes or cooldowns for heavy export testing.
retest: Focused Ahrefs retest immediately before the all-in-one stress run passed all three CSV exports in reports/main-ahrefs-retest2-20260425000618/results.jsonl.
